(program "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp#main"
  (packages "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/api" "std/maps" "std/net" "std/sim" "std/time" "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/app" "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/cache" "std/text" "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/db" "std/lists" "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/lb" "std/lesson" "std/random" "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp#main")
  (main "main"
    (vars (0 balancer local lb.Node) (1 servers local list of app.Node) (2 store local cache.Node) (3 database local db.Node) (4 s each app.Node) (5 keys local list of text) (6 i each number))
    (body
      (native "sim.seed" 9)
      (set balancer#0 (native "sim.spawn" (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/lb")))
      (set servers#1 (native "sim.cluster" 3 (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/app")))
      (set store#2 (native "sim.spawn" (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/cache")))
      (set database#3 (native "sim.spawn" (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/db")))
      (call "lb.Balance … on" servers#1 balancer#0)
      (each _ s#4 servers#1
        (call "app.Wire … to … and" s#4 store#2 database#3))
      (set keys#5 (list "home" "cart" "profile" "search" "help"))
      (each _ i#6 (native "lists.range" 1 150)
        (after (times:time i#6 (time 20000))
          (deliver (message api.Get (Key (native "random.pick" keys#5)) (Id i#6) (Start (native "time.now"))) balancer#0)))
      (call "lesson.Note" "Misses go to the database and fill the cache; hits come back fast.")
      (after (time 2000000)
        (native "sim.crash" store#2)
        (call "lesson.Ask … choosing" "The cache just crashed. What happens to new requests?" (list "They go straight to the database instead" "They hang: nothing answers and nothing times out" "The load balancer notices and retries on another cache" "They are served, only more slowly")))
      (native "sim.stopAt" (time 4000000))))
  (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/api"
    (runs "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/api")
    (record Get exported
      (field Key text exported "")
      (field Id number exported 0)
      (field Start time exported (time 0)))
    (record Lookup exported
      (field Key text exported "")
      (field Id number exported 0))
    (record CacheReply exported
      (field Key text exported "")
      (field Id number exported 0)
      (field Value text exported "")
      (field Found bool exported false))
    (record Query exported
      (field Key text exported "")
      (field Id number exported 0))
    (record Rows exported
      (field Key text exported "")
      (field Id number exported 0)
      (field Value text exported ""))
    (record Fill exported
      (field Key text exported "")
      (field Value text exported ""))
    (record Served exported
      (field Id number exported 0)
      (field Hit bool exported false)
      (field Latency time exported (time 0))))
  (package "std/maps" std
    (runs "std/maps"))
  (package "std/net" std
    (runs "std/net"))
  (package "std/sim" std
    (runs "std/sim"))
  (package "std/time" std
    (runs "std/time")
    (phrase "Every"
      (vars (0 d param time) (1 b block))
      (body
        (run-block b#1)
        (after d#0
          (call "time.Every" d#0
            (block
              (run-block b#1)))))))
  (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/app"
    (uses "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/api" "std/maps" "std/net" "std/sim" "std/time")
    (runs "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/api" "std/maps" "std/net" "std/sim" "std/time" "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/app")
    (node-fields
      (field Cache node exported (native "sim.nobody"))
      (field Db node exported (native "sim.nobody"))
      (field pending map of number to api.Get (empty map of number to api.Get)))
    (phrase "Wire … to … and"
      (vars (0 n param app.Node) (1 c param node) (2 d param node))
      (body
        (set-field n#0 app.Cache c#1)
        (set-field n#0 app.Db d#2)))
    (phrase "Finish … hit"
      (vars (0 n receiver app.Node) (1 r param api.Get) (2 h param bool))
      (body
        (set-field n#0 app.pending (native "maps.without" (recfield r#1 Id) (nodefield n#0 app.pending)))
        (emit (message api.Served (Id (recfield r#1 Id)) (Hit h#2) (Latency (minus:time (native "time.now") (recfield r#1 Start)))) n#0)))
    (when-node "net.received"
      (vars (0 n receiver app.Node) (1 api.Get binding api.Get) (2 balancer binding node))
      (match 0 record api.Get api.Get#1)
      (match 1 bind balancer#2)
      (body
        (set-item (nodefield n#0 app.pending) (recfield api.Get#1 Id) api.Get#1 map)
        (native "net.send" (message api.Lookup (Key (recfield api.Get#1 Key)) (Id (recfield api.Get#1 Id))) n#0 (nodefield n#0 app.Cache))))
    (when-node "net.received"
      (vars (0 n receiver app.Node) (1 api.CacheReply binding api.CacheReply) (2 cache binding node) (3 request local api.Get))
      (match 0 record api.CacheReply api.CacheReply#1)
      (match 1 bind cache#2)
      (body
        (set request#3 (item (nodefield n#0 app.pending) (recfield api.CacheReply#1 Id) map))
        (if (recfield api.CacheReply#1 Found)
          (then
            (call "app.Finish … hit" (recv n#0) request#3 true))
          (else
            (native "net.send" (message api.Query (Key (recfield request#3 Key)) (Id (recfield request#3 Id))) n#0 (nodefield n#0 app.Db))))))
    (when-node "net.received"
      (vars (0 n receiver app.Node) (1 api.Rows binding api.Rows) (2 db binding node) (3 request local api.Get))
      (match 0 record api.Rows api.Rows#1)
      (match 1 bind db#2)
      (body
        (set request#3 (item (nodefield n#0 app.pending) (recfield api.Rows#1 Id) map))
        (native "net.send" (message api.Fill (Key (recfield api.Rows#1 Key)) (Value (recfield api.Rows#1 Value))) n#0 (nodefield n#0 app.Cache))
        (call "app.Finish … hit" (recv n#0) request#3 false))))
  (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/cache"
    (uses "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/api" "std/net")
    (runs "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/api" "std/net" "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/cache")
    (node-fields
      (field Entries map of text to text exported (empty map of text to text)))
    (when-node "net.received"
      (vars (0 n receiver cache.Node) (1 api.Lookup binding api.Lookup) (2 asker binding node) (3 k local text))
      (match 0 record api.Lookup api.Lookup#1)
      (match 1 bind asker#2)
      (body
        (set k#3 (recfield api.Lookup#1 Key))
        (if (in k#3 (nodefield n#0 cache.Entries) map)
          (then
            (native "net.send" (message api.CacheReply (Key k#3) (Id (recfield api.Lookup#1 Id)) (Value (item (nodefield n#0 cache.Entries) k#3 map)) (Found true)) n#0 asker#2))
          (else
            (native "net.send" (message api.CacheReply (Key k#3) (Id (recfield api.Lookup#1 Id))) n#0 asker#2)))))
    (when-node "net.received"
      (vars (0 n receiver cache.Node) (1 api.Fill binding api.Fill) (2 filler binding node))
      (match 0 record api.Fill api.Fill#1)
      (match 1 bind filler#2)
      (body
        (set-item (nodefield n#0 cache.Entries) (recfield api.Fill#1 Key) (recfield api.Fill#1 Value) map))))
  (package "std/text" std
    (runs "std/text"))
  (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/db"
    (uses "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/api" "std/net" "std/text")
    (runs "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/api" "std/net" "std/text" "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/db")
    (node-fields
      (field Queries number exported 0))
    (when-node "net.received"
      (vars (0 n receiver db.Node) (1 api.Query binding api.Query) (2 asker binding node))
      (match 0 record api.Query api.Query#1)
      (match 1 bind asker#2)
      (body
        (set-field n#0 db.Queries (plus (nodefield n#0 db.Queries) 1))
        (after (time 40000)
          (native "net.send" (message api.Rows (Key (recfield api.Query#1 Key)) (Id (recfield api.Query#1 Id)) (Value (native "text.join" (list "row for " (recfield api.Query#1 Key))))) n#0 asker#2)))))
  (package "std/lists" std
    (runs "std/lists"))
  (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/lb"
    (uses "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/api" "std/lists" "std/net" "std/sim")
    (runs "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/api" "std/lists" "std/net" "std/sim" "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/lb")
    (node-fields
      (field Backends list of node exported (empty list of node))
      (field next number 0))
    (phrase "Balance … on"
      (vars (0 servers param list of node) (1 n param lb.Node))
      (body
        (set-field n#1 lb.Backends servers#0)))
    (when-node "sim.delivered"
      (vars (0 n receiver lb.Node) (1 api.Get binding api.Get))
      (match 0 record api.Get api.Get#1)
      (body
        (native "net.send" api.Get#1 n#0 (item (nodefield n#0 lb.Backends) (nodefield n#0 lb.next)))
        (set-field n#0 lb.next (plus (nodefield n#0 lb.next) 1))
        (if (is (nodefield n#0 lb.next) (native "lists.size" (nodefield n#0 lb.Backends)))
          (then
            (set-field n#0 lb.next 0))))))
  (package "std/lesson" std
    (uses "std/sim")
    (runs "std/sim" "std/lesson")
    (record Asked exported
      (field Question text exported "")
      (field Choices list of text exported (empty list of text)))
    (record Noted exported
      (field Text text exported ""))
    (phrase "Ask"
      (vars (0 q param text))
      (body
        (emit (message lesson.Asked (Question q#0)) (native "sim.nobody"))))
    (phrase "Ask … choosing"
      (vars (0 q param text) (1 c param list of text))
      (body
        (emit (message lesson.Asked (Question q#0) (Choices (native "lesson.choices" c#1))) (native "sim.nobody"))))
    (phrase "Note"
      (vars (0 t param text))
      (body
        (emit (message lesson.Noted (Text t#0)) (native "sim.nobody")))))
  (package "std/random" std
    (runs "std/random"))
  (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp#main" main
    (uses "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/api" "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/app" "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/cache" "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/db" "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/lb" "std/lesson" "std/lists" "std/random" "std/sim" "std/time")
    (runs "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/api" "std/maps" "std/net" "std/sim" "std/time" "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/app" "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/cache" "std/text" "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/db" "std/lists" "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp/lb" "std/lesson" "std/random" "github.com/synodlang/examples/webapp#main")))
